glossary.ja: オーガニック・プレート
glossary.role: The disc-shaped plates Orphan produces, from which Antibodies are revived.
The otherworld between sea and land where Dunbine takes place.
Class of insect-like Byston Well mecha fielded by the Drake Army and Show's side.
Organic mecha born from Orphan plates (Grand Chers and Brains).
Psychically evolved human; said of Amuro (m6022#149) and Kou (m6033#103).
The people who serve Orphan and pilot Grand Chers to gather its plates; plural 'Reclaimers'
MSC-07 Pegasus-class Federation assault carrier commanded by Sinapus.
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers
Latest Ark-series transforming machine from the UCE Design Bureau; Tak's (and initially Marina's red) unit; can call Guardian satellite strikes.
Reclaimer ace of Orphan; pilots Jonathan Grand Cher, later Jonathan Baronz; Yuu's rival and the son of Novis Noah's captain Anoa McCormick
glossary.personality: Arrogant, aggressive and taunting, full of resentment toward Yuu and his own mother. Loyal to Baron Maximilian.

glossary.role: Title Aura Battler; Sho's first unit; Marvel's playable unit in ACE2
Drake army Aura Battler (Garalia's pink custom in the series)
Female lead; 17-year-old Brain Powerd pilot (Hime Brain) aboard the Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Cheerful, warm and motherly toward the children and her Brain. Optimistic and brave, and believes in talking to people and Antibodies alike.

glossary.role: The aura energy of a pilot; also the name of a Dunbine-family ability that multiplies attack power for a while (Weapon 6).
Knight in Burn's squadron of Drake's army; pilots Drumlo, Virunvee and Bastole
glossary.personality: Fiercely ambitious and hot-tempered. Desperate to win glory and restore her family name, which was disgraced when her parents defected. Has a rivalry with Sho.

glossary.role: Male lead; former Reclaimer who escapes Orphan and pilots Yuu Brain, later Nelly Brain, for Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Brooding lone wolf who resents his scientist parents. Often acts alone, but values life and comes to fight to save his sister Quincy.

glossary.role: Life energy of Byston Well that powers aura machines; used alone in lines like オーラの力 / 悪しきオーラ / オーラ光.
Protagonist; Holy Warrior (Seisenshi) from Tokyo summoned to Byston Well; defects from Drake Luft to the resistance; pilots Dunbine, later Billbine
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, stubborn young motocross racer who grows into a serious, driven warrior. Has huge Aura Power but struggles to control it. Has unspoken feelings for Marvel.

glossary.role: Short for Brain Powerd units (ブレンたち, ブレンパワード隊).

glossary.note: Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer

glossary.role: Female lead; 17-year-old Brain Powerd pilot (Hime Brain) aboard the Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Cheerful, warm and motherly toward the children and her Brain. Optimistic and brave, and believes in talking to people and Antibodies alike.

report.translator_summary: Show Zama and Garalia Nyamhee clash in Tokyo Bay; Hime Utsumiya intervenes believing neither truly wants to fight. Show convinces Garalia that dying on the Upper Earth is pointless and offers to combine their Aura Power to open the Aura Road back to Byston Well. Both Aura Battlers resonate and trigger an aura jump, vanishing from radar. Captain Sinapus orders the Albion to cease attack and recall all units to resume pursuit of Zeon forces and the stolen Gundam Unit 2. In debriefing, Sinapus reveals Zeon's Asian transport was a decoy and that the real submarine headed to Africa. With Organic Plates appearing in Africa as well, Yuu Isami and Hime Utsumiya join the Albion for the investigation. Sinapus also notes Preventer has no intelligence on the two mysterious insect-like machines (Aura Battlers).

Show Zama's exclamation '南無三！' translated as 'Heaven help us!' reflecting his traditional Buddhist prayer/plea as the aura phenomenon opens.
